matchers/js/cypress/matcher.yaml

id: cypress
role: tool
classification: [js, e2e]
description: A `CypressError` or a retry timeout, with the command log leading up to it.
pattern: CypressError|Timed out retrying after \d+ms
before: 3
after: 12
